name: Codebase Design
description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
longDescription: An **eight-term glossary** used exactly (module, interface, implementation, depth, seam, adapter, leverage, locality), with "component", "service", "API" and "boundary" banned. Depth means leverage per unit of interface, not Ousterhout's line ratio. **Four principles**: depth belongs to the interface, the deletion test, the interface is the test surface, and one adapter means a hypothetical seam. **Three testability rules** with TypeScript examples: accept dependencies, return results, keep the surface small. Companion files `DEEPENING.md` (dependency categories, replace-don't-layer testing) and `DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md` (parallel sub-agents design an interface several ways, then compare).
